info.name: Control Tower
info.summary: Nextcloud orchestrator for admin, stacks, host health, and ops inbox
info.description:
**Control Tower** is the Nextcloud orchestrator for this GCS host — admin, stacks, health, and ops inbox in one place.
Fork of [Admin Cockpit](https://github.com/zomtec2311/admincockpit) by Wolfgang Tödt (AGPL-3.0), rebranded and extended.
- Unified admin pages (users, apps, system) - Host health and Docker stack status (via allowlisted sidecar) - Ops inbox visibility and Tools deep-links - Webmin / Portainer remain break-glass for deep OS and full Docker control
See CREDITS.md for attribution.
info.author: Wolfgang Tödt
Sarge
